summary.text: Erin Kerwin is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 40, where she assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said the issue she is most passionate about is repealing the cap on targeted education aid for Manchester.

paragraphs.text: Erin Kerwin was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and graduated from Shaker Heights High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from New York University in 1998 and a graduate degree from Simmons College in 2004.
Her career experience includes working as a homemaker, teacher, and social worker.
Kerwin advanced from the Democratic primary for Hillsborough 40 on September 8, 2026, finishing first among the candidates.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Manchester for 22 years and raised two children there, and that she has advocated in her first term for public education, affordable housing, healthcare access, and equal rights.
She also said she wants to reform the voucher program and has been posting weekly updates on upcoming bills for constituents in Wards 1, 3, 10, 11, and 12.
